scope: non-implementer review of R43 collision cleanup, runner preservation and shared finalization lock
reviewed_behaviors: Publisher lstat rejects existing regular/symlink/directory targets before creating a stage; native link remains the atomic no-overwrite operation.
Only link EEXIST cleans this invocation owned stage; cleanup failure retains original EEXIST plus cleanup metadata; failed write/sync/close stages remain failure evidence.
Runner parses and validates an event before append, rejects non-object/unknown-id/result-shape/duplicate events, and quarantines the offending line plus its buffered decoded tail.

DeepSeek requesting is checked against batch[requestedIds.size] and a result must match both activeRequestId and batch[resultRows.length] before append; these two latest order guards were source-reviewed, not directly exercised by the independent three-case Qwen byte-producer fixture.
Outcome is written to a unique same-directory wx stage and renamed only after write completion. The first complete checkpoint remains readable if a subsequent write fails.
Both diagnostic and formal holdout paths enter the same owned experiment lock for all allocation and terminal writes.

Assessment takes the shared lock across result reads, synthetic scoring and immutable publication when result-read realpath or output-parent realpath lies under this experiment results; generic unrelated tmp CLI/library remains compatible.
Summary CLI build+publish/check and full verifier enumeration+manifest publication use the same lock. verifyPreflight stays read-only and unlocked to avoid recursive lock acquisition in a runner.
Lock directory remains outside immutable results, with no stale inference/removal and existing ownership-checked release.
limitations: No model worker, network inference, frozen-data recomputation, historical CLI, full check, HTTP or deployment was run. The assessment CLI executes only zero-document synthetic inputs; summary uses synthetic report fixtures.

Finalizer busy tests use a real filesystem lock with synthetic holdout owner metadata. The separate runner test uses the actual runner CLI with a local Node byte producer, synthetic two-case hash/prompt preflight, and no model.
Native fs operations remain real; barriers/faults intercept selected calls and delegate native operations. They are bounded injected failure cases, not operating-system disk failure observations.
Cooperative lock scope does not authenticate arbitrary external filesystem writers or eliminate symlink TOCTOU races. No automatic recovery of an interrupted lock is claimed.
Independent run3 does not claim full original verifier/reseal validation; the author separate 17-case suite and parent future integration/CI remain distinct evidence.
